## Decisions and work

1. Repair the v1.0.28 → v1.0.30 release drift with the smallest product-sync change: global release/source identity, Changelog, `llms.txt`, and operating state. Preserve the existing Homebrew contribution on `/releases/`.
2. After that factual repair is published, deliver one distinct substantive search-facing outcome before closing the cycle. The selected content direction is a first-party engineering analysis of Docker-backed native agent sessions: how the host/container bridge preserves provider state in the container, how exact routing handles collisions and unavailable peers, and why Docker socket authority remains a separate trust boundary.
3. Do not react to noisy search-index lag or the unrelated Shopify brand collision with redirects, renaming, or metadata churn.
